name: SID
author: hundekraft
description: Based on Hermit’s cRSID, SID combines three oscillators per note with a resonant filter. The modes cover triangle, saw, pulse, noise, oscillator sync and ring modulation. It is inspired by the 8580 chip, not an exact copy of one. Use the OP-1's normal ADSR page to shape each note. Turn blue to choose a waveform and white to open or close the filter. The cutoff number shows control position, not hertz.
credits: Adapts Hermit (Mihaly Horvath)'s cRSID 1.58 light renderer
